1. **Exclusion of Multiples of 7**:

2. **Increment Pattern**:  
   After each power of two (e.g., 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, ...), the sequence increments by **1, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, ...** (doubling the increment each time). This creates blocks of numbers around powers of two.

   - **Start with $ a(1) = 1 $**.

Let $ a(n) $ denote the $ n $-th term of the sequence. The recursive rule is:

$$
a(n) = 
\begin{cases}
a(n-1) + 1 & \text{if } a(n-1) + 1 \not\equiv 0 \mod 7, \\
a(n-1) + 2 & \text{if } a(n-1) + 1 \equiv 0 \mod 7 \text{ and } a(n-1) + 2 \not\equiv 0 \mod 7, \\
a(n-1) + 4 & \text{if } a(n-1) + 2 \equiv 0 \mod 7 \text{ and } a(n-1) + 4 \not\equiv 0 \mod 7, \\
\vdots & \vdots \\
\end{cases}
$$
